title: HeritageGate: A stage-gated, rights-aware platform with privacy-aware real-pilot evidence and SoftwareX release preparation for AI-assisted intangible cultural heritage projects
description:
HeritageGate is an open-source Python research-software platform for stage-gated, rights-aware, provenance-preserving AI-assisted intangible cultural heritage (ICH) research and productization. It implements a persistent Gate 0–7 workflow with normalized rights, authorization, cultural-element, model-run, expert-review, market-test, and revenue-distribution records; versioned consent-document registration with SHA-256 verification; privacy-aware participant enrollment that refuses direct identifiers and stores only keyed hashes of local source identifiers; automated data-quality checks; reproducible descriptive statistics with Wilson and seeded-bootstrap intervals; a local browser dashboard; and GitHub, Zenodo, and SoftwareX submission-release preparation.

The release is pure Python (3.10+) with no mandatory third-party runtime dependency and ships 73 automated tests. The bundled example data are synthetic and do not represent any real cultural heritage tradition, community, or human participant.
